description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Kobra 的 React 一次性验证码输入组件页，提供分段式 OTP 输入框，可查看并复制 input-otp.tsx、styles.css 与 prompt.md 三个文件。页面展示粘贴整段验证码、错误提示“Invalid code. Please try again.”、成功态扫光与逐位落位动画，并基于 input-otp、React、Tailwind 与 motion 实现。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Kobra Input OTP (https://kobra.systems/components/input-otp).
Technology stack: react, tailwind, motion, typescript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
